title: ID60015: Power Infrastructure: Generation
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Generation – conventional, non–conventional and renewable energy resources,
synchronous generators.
HVAC Transmission - Transmission line trends and preliminaries, corona effects
- power loss and audible noise, radio interference.
HVDC Transmission -General comparison of A.C. and D.C. transmission, AC\DC
converters and components, control and protection for HVDC systems. reactive
power management. integrated AC-DC systems
Distribution Systems - Radial, ring – power quality, automation, power system
component modeling, power flow and fault analysis
Protection - Typical faults in power systems, basic protection elements
(circuit breakers, isolators, sectionalizing switches, fuses and relays), relay
types and protection principles, coordination of protection devices.
